boundaries.name: Poseidon2Permutation
boundaries.obligation: The audited Poseidon2-BabyBear permutation, its round constants and the upstream Poseidon2Air round constraints are an opaque callback; preimage and collision resistance - hence unforgeability of the hash signature - are assumed, never proved.

boundaries.name: StarkSoundness
boundaries.obligation: stark::prove_batch / verify_batch, the hiding PCS and the Fiat-Shamir absorption of the public values are opaque; that a proof for other public values is rejected, and that the proof reveals nothing about sk_b, are assumed.

boundaries.name: KeccakDigest
boundaries.obligation: The IMPA channel-tx digest that becomes the message is taken as given eight-word input; keccak is never assumed injective or collision resistant here.

boundaries.name: MemberTreeBinding
boundaries.obligation: That the pk_b handed to the verifier is the one registered in the sender's MemberLeaf (the off-chain P3-5 lookup) happens outside this file and is not modelled.

boundaries.name: ReplayDiscipline
boundaries.obligation: The scheme has no nonce, counter or expiry: the same (pk_b, m) proof stays valid forever, so uniqueness and single-use of the channel-tx digest must be enforced by the relying party.

boundaries.name: CanonicalRepresentatives
boundaries.obligation: Field elements are modelled by canonical representatives in [0,q) with fadd = (+) % q; that the Rust/plonky3 arithmetic agrees with this convention is assumed.

boundaries.name: Plonky3Lowering
boundaries.obligation: That the Rust AIR impl really enforces the gate set the model states (selector one-hotness, sk broadcast, pk-row and chaining equalities) is assumed.

boundaries.name: NativeTargetRefinement
boundaries.obligation: RNG sampling, Debug redaction, Bytes32 packing, trace matrix construction and error strings are not translated.
